executiveSummary: U.S. multi-agency advisories confirm active, state-affiliated exploitation of PLCs (Rockwell, Schneider, Siemens) in Water/Wastewater, Energy, and Government Facilities, including logic tampering and alarm suppression; immediate removal of internet exposure and controller lock-down are critical Security Advisory . A separate joint advisory warns of active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs using AI-assisted scripts (snap7/S7comm) to enumerate and issue read/write operations; defenders should block TCP/102 at perimeters, harden TIA Portal/STEP 7, and baseline S7 traffic Security Advisory . China-nexus actors leverage large covert networks of compromised SOHO routers and IoT devices (e.g., Volt Typhoon tradecraft) to pre-position in critical infrastructure and obfuscate operations; edge device hardening, segmentation, and egress controls are priority actions Security Advisory . Supply-chain implants in re-branded ZBT/Zbtlink LTE/SOHO routers ("SPEAKINGSTONE," "DARKLANTERN") enable unauthenticated command execution, credential theft, DNS hijacking, and reverse SSH; these devices commonly sit at OT edges-inventory, isolate, and replace/reflash as needed View Article Supporting Report . Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC threatens VPN/AAA gateways widely used to front OT remote access; patch to fixed builds and hunt for web shells/abnormal SAML traffic Security Advisory . FortiGate credential/config leaks ("FortiBleed") affect 86k+ devices worldwide; rotate all admin/VPN creds, enforce PBKDF2 hashing (FortiOS ≥7.2.11), and review logs for config exports and Kerberos/NTLM abuse Security Advisory . ICS-specific vulnerabilities surged across CISA weekly bulletins: Eclipse Milo (OPC UA) server flaws enabling unauthorized reads/writes and DoS; EV chargers, rail signaling, and utility metering exposures require urgent patching and segmentation Security Advisory Security Advisory . Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced gateways ship with unauthenticated Node-RED HTTP interface (CVE-2026-58115) allowing max-privilege command execution; upgrade to V4.3.4.1+ and harden/disable Node-RED in production Security Advisory . Exploitation of ownCloud CVE-2023-49105 led to exfiltration of nuclear-adjacent research records; treat exposed WebDAV and CMS as potential enterprise ingress toward OT-patch, restrict, and rotate secrets View Article . KEV updates add high-risk perimeter and server CVEs (Cisco ASA/FTD, Windows AFD, Metabase, LoadMaster); remediate rapidly, validate pre-patch compromise, and restrict/monitor management interfaces Security Advisory Security Advisory .

items: Iran-affiliated APT activity: PLC project exfiltration and AOI/ladder manipulation with HMI alarm suppression in W/WW, Energy, and Government Facilities Security Advisory .
PRC-linked QTFY (QT/QTCYBER) targeting U.S. infrastructure via perimeter VPN flaws and custom proxy platforms; apply hotfixes and restrict exposure View Article .
Pro-Russia hacktivist clusters opportunistically compromise VNC-exposed HMIs/SCADA to deface, change setpoints, and lock out operators; remove VNC exposure, enforce MFA Security Advisory .

relevance: The reporting window features concurrent, validated threats that directly target industrial control equipment and the IT/OT boundary: (1) multi-agency confirmation of active PLC manipulation; (2) AI-assisted reconnaissance and S7 command issuance against Siemens S7 families; (3) widespread compromise or backdoor presence in low-cost cellular/SOHO routers often used as remote site gateways; and (4) pre-auth exploitation of enterprise ADC/VPN appliances used to broker remote access to ICS environments. Multiple ICS-specific CVE clusters (OPC UA servers, EV charging/OCPP, metering, rail signaling, HMI/SCADA tools, industrial gateways) compound risk. The immediate priority is to remove internet exposure, harden perimeters, enforce strict segmentation and monitored conduits, and verify controller integrity.

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190) on NetScaler/Metabase/LoadMaster; Valid Accounts (T1078) via FortiGate leaks and email compromise.
Discovery & Lateral: Network Service Scanning (T1046) including TCP/102 S7comm; abuse of VPN/AAA pathways; IoT/SOHO botnet pivots.
Execution & Persistence: Web shells on ADC (T1505), malicious Node-RED flows on gateways; reverse SSH tunnels from backdoored routers.
ICS-Specific: Modify Controller Logic (ICS T0831), Program Download (ICS T0843), Inhibit Response Function (ICS T0803), Change Operating Mode (ICS T0800).
Exfiltration: WebDAV bulk download (ownCloud), HTTP/S exfil via ADC/reverse proxies; DNS/HTTPS over covert channels.

outlook72h: Expect rapid exploitation attempts of NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 on any publicly reachable SAML SP/IdP endpoints. Prioritize emergency maintenance to patch and restrict exposure. Scanning for Siemens S7 TCP/102 and opportunistic write attempts likely to continue; increase alerting thresholds for new S7 comms and off-hours activity. Detection of ZBT/Zbtlink router beacons and UDP listeners may spike as disclosures propagate; preempt with egress blocks and accelerated edge replacement. Further KEV additions probable for perimeter/VPN and enterprise middleware; align patching workflows to BOD 26-04 prioritization (exposure, KEV status, automation potential).
